methodology.inclusion: filled trades entered at or after cutoff, closed or settled by asof; archived trade cycles included
methodology.exclusions: cancelled, open/unresolved, and removed unconfirmed purchases; no deleted record is counted as a confirmed fill
methodology.fees: Recorded fees when present, otherwise the application default of $0.0194 per CT per buy or sell. No sale fee for settlement.
methodology.prices: Recorded execution price when present, otherwise recorded order limit. Quote excursions are indicative, not executable bid prices.
methodology.causality: Descriptive associations, not isolated causal effects; rule, entry time, price, and configuration are confounded.
